# Joey's 1 Stop Tire

> New & used tires based in Cedar Park, Texas. New tires from all the brands, used tires, flat repair, rotation, balancing and emissions inspections. Family owned since 2021, walk-ins welcome, and prices customers keep coming back for.

- Phone: (512) 259-9041
- Based in: Cedar Park, TX
- Service area: Cedar Park, Leander, Liberty Hill, Round Rock, Brushy Creek, Jonestown
- Google rating: 4.7 from 391 reviews
- Request a quote: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/tire-shops/texas/joeys-1-stop-tire/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/tire-shops/texas/joeys-1-stop-tire/book.html

## Services
- New tires: All the brands, for cars, trucks and SUVs. Tell us your size and we'll check what's on the rack or get it in.
- Used tires: Racks of good used tires inside the bays, for when you need one tire or a set without paying new-tire money.
- Flats & wheel repair: Picked up a nail on 183? Pull in and we'll patch it, or tell you straight if the tire needs replacing.
- Rotation & balancing: Even wear and a smooth ride on the highway. The work that makes a set of tires last.
- Inspections, lights & wipers: We do inspections. Burned-out bulb or streaky wipers? We can swap them while you're here.
- Trailer & ATV tires: Trailer repair and the tires other shops turn away, like ATV tires mounted on their wheels.

## About
Joey's 1 Stop Tire is a family-owned and operated tire shop at 2103 N Bell Blvd in Cedar Park, and has been since 2021. Look for the JOEY'S 1 STOP sign on the limestone pillars by the road, then the two red-trimmed metal shops and the limestone office under the big oak tree, with new tires stacked out front. We sell new tires from all the brands and keep racks of used ones inside. We fix flats and wheels, rotate and balance, do emissions inspections, replace headlights, taillights, wiper blades and bulbs, and handle trailer repair. No appointment needed. Customers say the same things again and again: friendly people, quick service, fair prices and nobody trying to get over on you. Plenty of them are in and out in under half an hour, and several have been coming back for years with more than one vehicle.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: No. Walk-ins are welcome Monday to Friday 7:30 AM to 6 PM and Saturday 8 AM to 3 PM. Busy afternoons can mean a short wait, so calling ahead at (512) 259-9041 helps.
- Q: Do you sell used tires?
  A: Yes. We carry new tires from all the brands and a stock of used tires. Call with your tire size (it's on the sidewall and the driver's door sticker) and we'll check the racks.
- Q: How much is a flat repair or a rotation?
  A: Our posted prices are $24 for a flat tire repair, $30 for a tire rotation and $60 for tire balancing. Tire prices depend on the size, so call (512) 259-9041 for a price.
- Q: Can I get my inspection done here?
  A: Yes, we do emissions inspections. If a bulb is out or the wipers are worn, we can replace them while you're here.
- Q: How can I pay?
  A: Credit cards and pay-by-phone both work, and lease-to-own is available through Acima.
- Q: Where are you and when are you open?
  A: 2103 N Bell Blvd, Suite B, Cedar Park, TX 78613. Monday to Friday 7:30 AM to 6 PM, Saturday 8 AM to 3 PM, closed Sunday.
